wakeHolds.possible_draft: waiting: there may be an unsent draft. Send it, or type x then Ctrl+C.
wakeHolds.awaiting_prompt: not yet taken: the agent may be waiting at a prompt. Check its pane.
wakeHolds.paste_open: waiting: a paste into its input has not finished.
wakeHolds.cannot_type: waiting for the agent to fetch it. Send it a prompt.
wakeHolds.not_taken: waiting: the agent did not take the deck's Enter. Send it a prompt.
wakeHolds.uncertain_input: waiting: the deck's notice may be in its input. Check it before Enter.
wakeHolds.dialog_during_ring: waiting: a dialog may have taken the deck's keys. Check its pane.
wakeHolds.needs_fetch: waiting: ask the agent to run dot-agent-deck inbox fetch; reinstall the deck integration to restore automatic delivery
wakeHolds.cannot_check: waiting: the deck can't check this agent's input box. Check its pane.

inputHeld.checking: input held: the deck is checking the input box; your typing will appear in a moment
inputHeld.check_not_opened: input held: the agent hasn't opened the deck's check yet; your typing is kept until it does. Restarting the agent discards it.
inputHeld.check_not_returned: input held: the agent hasn't come back from the deck's check; your typing is kept until it does. Restarting the agent discards it.
inputHeld.after_your_ctrl_g: input held: the agent didn't open the editor for your Ctrl+G; your typing is kept. Restarting the agent discards it.
inputHeld.queue_full: input held: too much typing is waiting; the rest is paused
inputHeld.check_blocked: waiting: the deck can't check this input box until you press Ctrl+G
inputHeld.unknown: input held: your typing is kept while the deck checks this input box

cannotCheckDetail: waiting: the deck can't check this agent's input box: {cause}. {remedy}

holdCauses.filesystem: {path} is on {filesystem}, which the check doesn't support
holdCauses.writable_directory: others can write to {path}, a directory you own
holdCauses.acl: an access control list on {path} lets others write to it, or can't be read
holdCauses.export_file: the agent's file {path} isn't one the check can trust

holdPathUnnamed: a path the deck didn't name
holdFilesystemUnnamed: a filesystem the deck didn't name

holdRemedies.relocate: Point TMPDIR (or CODEX_HOME) at a directory on ext4, XFS, Btrfs or tmpfs (Linux), or APFS or HFS+ (macOS), owned by you, with no group or other write permission on it or on any directory above it other than a sticky directory root owns, such as /tmp.
holdRemedies.remove_write: Remove the write permission others have on that directory, with chmod g-w (and chmod o-w if others can write too) on it.
holdRemedies.reread: Check that you can read it, or point TMPDIR (or CODEX_HOME) at another directory.

wakeHoldsAlone.uncertain_input: The deck's notice may be in its input. Check it before pressing Enter.
wakeHoldsAlone.dialog_during_ring: A dialog may have taken the deck's keys. Check the agent's pane.

uncertainReason: a deck message may or may not have reached this agent. Retry sends it again marked as a possible repeat; Cancel stops delivering it.
outOfAttempts: out of attempts: the deck sent this message as many times as it allows. Cancel it, or post it again.
heldLong: the agent has had a deck message for an hour without confirming it. It may still be working on it.
notStarted: may not have reached the agent
notStartedReason: the agent has been idle for a few minutes and the deck has not seen it start on this deck message, so the message may not have reached it. Retry sends it again, so the agent may get it twice. Cancel stops further delivery but cannot take back a copy the agent already has.
retryLimit: retry limit reached; Cancel it, or post it again
actionStale: another client already acted on this message; the card shows where it stands now
actionSettled: it reached the agent after all
actionGone: this message no longer needs a decision
retryApplied: sent again, marked as a possible repeat
adapterTooOld: this agent's deck integration is out of date; restart the agent to update it
cliTooOld: the dot-agent-deck command this agent runs does not support this deck's integration: upgrade dot-agent-deck, then restart the agent
notArmed: this agent's deck integration has not connected yet; its messages wait until it does
refreshFailed: the deck could not update this agent's deck integration: run dot-agent-deck hooks install --agent opencode to see why, then restart the agent
refreshFailedPi: the deck could not update this agent's Pi extension: run dot-agent-deck orchestrator setup with the same HOME and PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR as the agent to see why, then restart the agent
hooksTooOld: this agent's deck hooks run a dot-agent-deck too old for its messages
hooksTooOldUpgrade: upgrade the dot-agent-deck the hooks run, or run hooks install from the copy you want them to use, then restart the agent
receiptsDegraded: messages may repeat: the deck cannot record message receipts for this agent
admissionRefusedRemedy: Restart it from the deck; messages addressed to it are not handed to the restarted agent, so have them sent again.

admissionCauses.inbox_other_user: a process running as another user asked for them
admissionCauses.inbox_peer_unidentified: the deck could not identify the process that asked for them
admissionCauses.inbox_component_not_caller: its integration named a process other than its own
admissionCauses.inbox_nested_agent: an agent of the same kind running inside it asked for them
admissionCauses.inbox_not_agent_process: a process outside the agent asked for them
admissionCauses.inbox_receiver_above_agent: its integration named a process the agent itself runs under

evidencePaused: deck messages paused: {n} delivered messages still wait for proof that older copies cannot run; restart the agent to clear them
actionUnsupported: this deck cannot Retry or Cancel deck messages: upgrade dot-agent-deck

cardTerminations.pane_command_exited: not delivered: the command started in the agent's pane exited (code {code}) before taking this message
cardTerminations.connection_ended: not delivered: the deck's connection to the agent's pane ended before it took this message; whether the agent is still running is unknown
cardTerminations.replaced: not delivered: the agent's pane was replaced before it took this message; the message stays with the previous agent
cardTerminations.closed: not delivered: the pane was closed before the agent took this message
cardTerminations.unknown: not delivered: the agent's pane ended before it took this message

terminations.pane_command_exited: the command started in the agent's pane exited (code {code}) before taking this message
terminations.connection_ended: the deck's connection to the agent's pane ended before it took this message; whether the agent is still running is unknown
terminations.replaced: the agent's pane was replaced before it took this message; the message stays with the previous agent
terminations.closed: the pane was closed before the agent took this message
terminations.unknown: the agent's pane ended before it took this message
